results.description: Everything that can be found. Each item is a doc ({ title, path, snippet, body, author, updated, readMinutes }), a person ({ person, title, role, snippet, email, location, owns }), or a file ({ title, ext, size, snippet, owner, updated, photo?, pages? }), all with an id and a team.

teams.description: Team facet options ({ id, label }) in display order.

recentSearches.description: Recent queries shown first in the suggestions. Runs are added to the front, up to five.

suggestedSearches.description: Suggested queries shown under recent ones and offered again when nothing matches.

defaultQuery.description: Query shown and run on first render.

defaultSort.description: Initial sort: best match, newest first, or A to Z.

today.description: ISO day that relative dates and the edited range are measured from, so the server and client render the same labels.

workspace.description: Workspace name used in the placeholder and the region label.

latency.description: Simulated query time in milliseconds while skeletons show. 0 shows results at once.

onSearch.description: Called each time a query runs, from Enter, a suggestion, a spelling fix, or an empty state suggestion.

onOpen.description: Called when the preview's primary action (Open doc, View profile, Download) completes.
